title: Exact certification of the coordinate fields of the triangle-free Exoo-Ismailescu unit-distance graphs EI17 and EI19 (HoG 51375, 51376): a solvable-non-solvable dichotomy (origami vs. S20) and the Laman-number conjecture
summary: We certify, exactly, the coordinate fields of a faithful planar realization of two neighbouring triangle-free Exoo-Ismailescu unit-distance graphs (UDGs), and show they realize the two opposite extremes of the constructibility hierarchy. The 17-vertex graph EI17 (House of Graphs 51375) is the smallest triangle-free UDG with chromatic number 4; the 19-vertex graph EI19 (HoG 51376) is its state-of-the-art origami neighbour. In both, fixing a rational base edge, the remaining vertices are intersections of unit circles -- each on the radical axis of its two neighbours, a tower of square roots…
